# WebHookRegistrationUpdateRequest

Changes a web hook's URL, secret or headers. Its type can't change.

**Kind:** an object, used in requests.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | `string` | yes | The URL to call. Constraints: format: url, required (empty or whitespace-only strings are rejected). |
| `secret` | `string \| null` |  | A new secret to sign calls with (`X-MT-WebHook-Signature`). Null or omitted: the stored secret is kept. Constraints: minLength: 1. |
| `headers` | `map<string, string \| null> \| null` |  | The complete set of headers the web hook has after the update: a name left out is removed, and `{}` clears them all. Values are write-only (responses show `********`), so a value of `null` or `********` keeps the stored value for that name; any other string replaces it. Omitting `headers` (or sending `null`) leaves every header unchanged. |
| `signedOnly` | `boolean \| null` |  | True stops a web hook registered before deliveries were signed from sending its secret in `X-MT-WebHook-Secret`: from then on its deliveries are only signed, like every web hook registered now. It can't be undone, so false or omitted changes nothing. |

## Example

```json
{
  "url": "...",
  "secret": "...",
  "headers": {
    "key": "..."
  },
  "signedOnly": false
}
```

## Where it's used

- [`webhooks.update`](../api/webhooks.md) (`PUT /web-hooks/by-id/{id}`)
